product_one_liner.value: Blue Triangle helps enterprise digital teams measure how website and mobile-app friction affects conversions and revenue, prioritize fixes, and assess the business impact of improvements.

pricing_page.notes: A publicly accessible plan-comparison page lists packages and custom enterprise pricing, although it uses older branding.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 23 employees; PitchBook reports 49. Both fall within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The public index is a product, marketing, and web-performance blog; the required two engineer-authored posts about building Blue Triangle itself were not established.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The public investor job board states that the company has no jobs relevant to that board at this time; the official careers page exposes no role listings.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed product documentation, AI-agent and MCP documentation, blog, privacy/security materials, and the subprocessor list. They identify supported third-party AI clients, but do not disclose the backend model or provider powering Blue Triangle’s own AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims only: the trust center offers SOC-2 and ISO27001 documentation by request; security documentation refers to an ISO27001 certificate and annual external audit. GDPR is a compliance claim, not a certification. No independent validation of report scope or validity is implied.

last_funding.notes: Latest reported round: November 9, 2021. The round amount is undisclosed and therefore omitted; total funding is not substituted for the round amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported funding round is November 9, 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public investor job board has no relevant current jobs; its SDR posting explicitly says it is no longer accepting applications.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 2026 announcement introduces the MCP Connector, enabling AI assistants to query Blue Triangle monitoring and revenue data; this is within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Interpreting “join or leave” as joining or leaving the company, not internal promotion: the small leadership team was reviewed and no in-window external arrival or departure was verified. Emily Salzer became VP of Customer Success in January 2026, but her profile shows she had already been at Blue Triangle since August 2022. Shannan Hanson’s departure was September 2024, outside the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The archived SDR job description names these systems; the CMO separately describes an inbound-lead workflow in HubSpot. These are historical visible signals, not confirmation that every system remains deployed today.
